Open-source AI coding framework

Usage:
  noodle [flags]
  noodle [command]

Available Commands:
  admission   Inspect or retire a rejected initial proposal with the stopped owner
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  event       Manage loop events
  help        Help about any command
  reset       Clear all runtime state
  schema      Print generated schema docs for Noodle runtime contracts
  skills      List resolved skills
  start       Run the scheduling loop
  status      Show compact runtime status
  version     Print noodle version
  worktree    Manage linked git worktrees

Flags:
  -h, --help                 help for noodle
      --project-dir string   project directory (default: current directory, env: NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR)
      --version              Print noodle version

Use "noodle [command] --help" for more information about a command.
